how_to_apply: tokens[]: in <file>, delete the declaration of <old> (light + dark) when kind is semantic/primitive, and replace every var(<old>) with var(<new>).
kind=component: rename <old> to <new> and define it once, look/theme-independently, as defined_as (or a literal if none).
kind=alias: the token aliased another local token; it follows that token.
hard_coded[]: replace the literal in that property with var(<new>); rows with theme=dark are normally deleted once the light rule uses a token.
confidence=low or keep: do not apply mechanically; review by hand (see note).
